items.summary: Recommendation: pause incremental monetization and AI-intensive expansion until attribution and measurement reconcile. Amazon reported 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21; $4.92 is aggregate and unattributed, while site-attributed income is $0. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23 was $793.24 across 4,680 calls, including 207 errors. Revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, and measurement windows do not support a contribution-margin or revenue forecast claim.

Cost-to-learn is not calculable: experiments report zero completed, zero measured, and zero proven outcomes, and no experiment-level spend allocation or causal revenue is available. Minimum measurement is one registered hypothesis with treatment identifiers, exposure counts, incremental affiliate clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, AI cost, and a fixed measurement window; use 14 days or 100 eligible impressions, whichever comes later.

Do not treat SEO impressions, sessions, affiliate clicks, ordered items, or AI calls as revenue or margin. The 11 improvements awaiting measurement and zero proven outcomes are a financial stop signal for forecast-based investment. Continue only bounded report-only reconciliation and already-approved measurement gates; do not move money or authorize spend.
